items.title: CVE-2026-96457
items.description: A flaw was found in the administrative interface of Keycloak, an identity and access management solution. The issue occurs when Fine-Grained Admin Permissions are used to restrict a group administrator from managing specific sub-groups. Due to an incomplete fix for a previous vulnerability, a restricted administrator can bypass these restrictions by moving a forbidden sub-group to the top level of the hierarchy. This allows the attacker to gain unauthorized control over the groups members, potentially leading to a full takeover of the security realm.

items.title: CVE-2026-135262
items.description:
MISP contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Pivot Explorer component. The bundled pivotick visualization library (version 1.2.0) rendered all string values it received as HTML markup rather than as plain text. As a result, user-controllable data fields, including attribute comments, attribute values, and reference relationship types, were interpreted and executed as HTML/JavaScript in the Pivot Explorer tooltip and sidebar panels.

An authenticated user with the ability to create or modify MISP attributes could embed malicious HTML or script payloads in these fields. When another user (or the same user) opened the Pivot Explorer and viewed the affected event data, the injected markup would execute in the victim's browser context, potentially allowing session hijacking, data exfiltration, or unauthorized actions performed on behalf of the victim.

items.description:
MISP's brute-force lockout mechanism for login and one-time-password (OTP) authentication is susceptible to bypass through Unicode case-folding inconsistencies and input handling flaws.

- Database collation folding (accent and width variants) allows an attacker to reach a valid account using a folded alias of the email address without the attempt being recorded in the lockout counter.
- A password containing a NUL byte produces a distinct server error for known accounts while unknown accounts receive a different response, enabling username enumeration.

items.title: CVE-2026-135260
items.description:
MISP contains multiple flaws in its login and one-time-password (OTP) brute-force lockout mechanism that collectively weaken authentication protection.

- Lockout counter bypass: the lockout stored and matched usernames using a single-byte case-fold function. An email address containing a non-ASCII capital letter (for example a Latin-1 or Cyrillic uppercase) was never counted toward the lockout threshold, allowing unlimited failed login attempts against that account.
- Collation-folding authentication bypass: the database collation performs accent and width folding, so a Unicode variant of a valid address (e.g. a different diacritic or a full-width character) resolved to the same account during authentication while the lockout treated it as a distinct, untracked identity. An attacker could therefore authenticate as the target user using a folded alias without triggering the lockout.

items.title: CVE-2026-135259
items.description:
MISP contains a type confusion vulnerability in the authentication key creation endpoint. When a user submits a floating-point value as the target user identifier, the authorization check truncates the value to an integer (matching the attacker's own account), while the persistence layer rounds the same value to a different integer (the next account in the sequence). This discrepancy allows an authenticated user with key-creation permission to generate an API authentication key belonging to another user.

- The attacker must be an authenticated user with the permission to create authentication keys.
- The target user must have a consecutive numeric identifier immediately following the attacker's identifier.

Impact:
- Unauthorized creation of an API key for another user, granting the attacker access to that user's data and operations within the MISP instance.

items.description:

- A user with permission to edit their own object could inject a foreign attribute identifier into the object revision form. The revision data, stored in the server-side session, was merged into the stored object before the save diff was computed. The save then wrote to the foreign attribute row by its identifier without verifying that the row belonged to the caller's event or organisation, allowing an attacker to overwrite or soft-delete an attribute in another organisation's private event.

The export module constructs tab-separated lines for downstream Zeek/Bro intelligence feeds. The sanitization routine was intended to strip tab, newline, and carriage-return characters from user-controlled fields (organisation names and attribute values) before they were embedded into the export line format. items.title: CVE-2026-135256
items.description:
MISP contains a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) vulnerability in its Warninglist feature. Warninglist entries of type "regex" are evaluated against attribute values without any backtracking limit. An authenticated user with permission to add or import warninglist entries can supply a crafted regular expression pattern that triggers excessive backtracking in the PCRE engine, causing sustained CPU consumption and denial of service.

Additionally, imported warninglists were not validated for syntactic correctness before replacing existing entries, allowing malformed or malicious patterns to be persisted and later evaluated without prior rejection.

items.title: CVE-2026-135254
items.description:
MISP is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in its correlation management functionality.

The top-correlation cache regeneration and occurrence count regeneration actions were accessible via bodyless GET requests and were triggered from the admin interface using plain hyperlinks rather than POST forms. Because these state-changing operations did not require a POST method and were reachable through simple URL navigation, an attacker who can induce an authenticated administrator to visit a malicious page or click a crafted link can trigger these operations without the administrator's explicit consent.

Impact:
- Unintended triggering of resource-intensive correlation regeneration processes
- Potential disruption of correlation data processing and increased server load
- No direct data disclosure or corruption is evidenced

Affected: MISP versions prior to 2.5.52

items.title: CVE-2026-135253
items.description:
MISP's NIDS rule export functionality for Snort and Suricata formats does not properly escape user-controlled data before embedding it into generated rule text. Attribute values, tag names, and URL paths are inserted directly into rule options (msg, metadata, content matches) without neutralizing characters that are syntactically significant in the NIDS rule grammar, such as double quotes, semicolons, backslashes, commas, and control characters.

An authenticated user with the ability to create or modify attributes in a MISP instance can craft attribute values or tag names containing these special characters. items.title: CVE-2026-135252
items.description:
MISP contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its feed and sync HTTP request handling. When the application uses libcurl as the HTTP transport, the CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION option was enabled by default, causing the library to automatically follow HTTP redirects without the application's own per-hop validation logic being invoked.

- Feed requests: MISP implements its own redirect validation for feed sources, but libcurl was following redirects before that validation could execute, allowing a malicious or compromised feed source to redirect the request to arbitrary internal URLs.
- Sync requests: Sync peers are server-configured, and the application does not perform per-hop redirect validation for sync traffic. libcurl's automatic redirect following allowed a malicious sync peer to redirect the request to internal network resources.

items.title: CVE-2026-135250
items.description:
MISP contains a denial-of-service vulnerability in its image processing pipeline. When generating attachment thumbnails or rendering event graph preview images, the application decodes user-supplied image data using the GD library without first validating the declared pixel dimensions in the image header.

Because GD allocates its pixel buffers outside the scope of PHP's memory_limit directive, a crafted image with an extremely large declared resolution (for example, 20000 x 20000 pixels) can trigger a multi-gigabyte memory allocation during the decode step, exhausting available system memory and causing the PHP worker process or the host to become unresponsive.

Preconditions:
- An authenticated MISP user with permission to upload attachments or to create/view event graphs.
- The ability to supply a crafted image file (e.g., a PNG with a valid header declaring oversized dimensions).

items.title: CVE-2026-135249
items.description:
MISP accepted compressed HTTP request bodies (gzip, brotli, zstd) and decompressed them before authentication was performed, with no limit on the size of the resulting decompressed data. An unauthenticated attacker could send a small compressed payload that expands to a very large decompressed body, exhausting server memory and causing a denial of service. Brotli and zstd, with their high compression ratios, made the attack particularly effective.

The vulnerability required no authentication and no special conditions beyond the ability to send an HTTP request with a Content-Encoding header. The impact is a complete loss of availability for the affected MISP instance.

Affected: MISP versions prior to 2.5.52.

items.title: CVE-2026-135248
items.description:
MISP contains a vulnerability in its password reset (forgot password) functionality where the base URL used to construct the reset link sent by email could be derived from the HTTP request's Host header rather than from an explicitly configured value.

An unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted request with a malicious Host header. If the application's base URL was not explicitly configured (MISP.baseurl or MISP.external_baseurl), the bootstrap would derive it from the request, and the resulting password reset email would contain a link pointing to the attacker-controlled domain. When the victim clicks the link, they are directed to the attacker's site, enabling credential phishing or token theft.

Preconditions:
- The password reset feature (allow_password_forgotten) is enabled
- MISP.baseurl and MISP.external_baseurl are not explicitly set to trusted values

items.title: CVE-2026-135247
items.description:
MISP's LinOTPAuth plugin, used for one-time-password authentication against a LinOTP server, did not enforce TLS server certificate verification when the LinOTPAuth.verifyssl configuration option was not explicitly set. In a default or minimally configured deployment, the authentication request to the LinOTP server was sent without peer or peer-name certificate validation, effectively allowing self-signed or spoofed certificates.

An attacker with a network position between the MISP instance and the LinOTP server could perform a man-in-the-middle attack to intercept or tamper with the authentication exchange, potentially capturing one-time passwords or user credentials.

- The LinOTPAuth plugin is enabled and configured to communicate with a LinOTP server

items.title: CVE-2026-135245
items.description:
MISP's LDAP authentication components (LdapAuth plugin and Apache LDAP authentication) unconditionally re-enabled user accounts that had been disabled by an administrator. During the user provisioning or update step of an LDAP login, the disabled flag was reset to enabled regardless of the account's current state.

This allowed any user with valid LDAP credentials to bypass an administrative disable action simply by authenticating, effectively nullifying the ability to revoke access through account deactivation.

- Affects the LdapAuth plugin and the ApacheSecureAuth component
- The insecure behavior was the default; no special configuration was required to trigger it
- An administrator's decision to disable a user (e.g., after a security incident or employee departure) could be reversed by the user's next successful LDAP login

Affected versions: MISP prior to 2.5.52

items.title: CVE-2026-135244
items.description:
MISP trusted client-supplied forwarded IP headers (such as X-Forwarded-For) without verifying that the request originated from a known proxy or that the value was a valid IP address. The configured header value was accepted as the authoritative client IP for all security-relevant functions.

An unauthenticated remote attacker could forge the forwarded header to:
- Bypass IP-based restrictions on API authentication keys
- Evade brute-force / rate-limiting protection
- Inject arbitrary values into application and ECS logs, corrupting audit trails

The vulnerability required the MISP.log_client_ip_header setting to be configured to a forwarded header (e.g. HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR), which is a common deployment when MISP sits behind a reverse proxy.

Affected: MISP versions prior to 2.5.52

items.title: CVE-2026-135243
items.description: MISP contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the handling of sightings during server synchronization and bulk operations. The vulnerability allows a remote attacker with access to a synchronized MISP instance to pull sightings for events that are not shared with their organization or community. The sighting pull mechanism previously executed with elevated privileges and accepted event identifiers without verifying that the local event was authorized for sharing with the remote server. Additionally, the bulk save functionality for sightings did not strictly enforce that the attributes referenced in the request belonged to the specific event specified in the URL, allowing an attacker to associate sightings with unauthorized events by referencing attributes from other events. items.title: CVE-2026-135242
items.description:
MISP contains an authorization flaw in the Sharing Group Blueprint execution path. When a blueprint is executed, it rewrites the organisation roster of the associated sharing group. The check verifying that the blueprint's owning organisation still holds the right to extend (modify) that group was performed only once, at the time the blueprint was created. It was not re-evaluated at execution time.

As a result, an organisation that subsequently lost its extend permission or was entirely removed from the sharing group could still execute its existing blueprint and overwrite the group's organisation roster, adding or removing member organisations at will.

items.title: CVE-2026-135241
items.description:
MISP contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the handling of Galaxy and Galaxy Cluster publish/unpublish operations. The application failed to enforce consistent permission checks when users attempted to unpublish a Galaxy or Galaxy Cluster. Specifically, the unpublish action only required the 'perm_galaxy_editor' permission, whereas the publish action required both 'perm_galaxy_editor' and 'perm_publish'.

This inconsistency allowed a user from a different organization who possessed the 'perm_galaxy_editor' permission but lacked the 'perm_publish' permission to unpublish a Galaxy or Galaxy Cluster created by another organization. This action could disrupt the availability of shared threat intelligence data for other users and organizations relying on that cluster.

The vulnerability affects MISP versions prior to 2.5.52.

items.title: CVE-2026-135240
items.description:
MISP contains an authorization bypass in its tag attachment functionality. The endpoints responsible for editing event tags, editing attribute tags, and adding tags to event reports accepted arbitrary tag IDs without verifying whether the authenticated user was permitted to attach the referenced tag.

The events/addTag endpoint already resolved tag IDs through a restricted lookup that enforced per-user and per-organisation tag visibility rules. However, the three tag-editor endpoints (editEventTags, editAttributeTags, and eventReports/addTag) passed the supplied tag IDs directly to the attachment logic without any such check.

Preconditions:
- An authenticated user with tagger and add permissions on the target event/attribute/report.
- Knowledge or discovery of a tag ID that is restricted (local_only) to another organisation.

items.title: CVE-2026-135239
items.description:
MISP contains an authorization flaw in the data capture and import paths for events, galaxies, galaxy clusters, analyst data, and sightings. A user who is neither a sync user nor a site admin could create or import records attributed to an organisation other than their own, or cause the creation of a new organisation from a payload-supplied identifier.

The root cause is an inconsistent authorization check: the code validated one representation of the creator organisation (for example a numeric ID or a UUID field) while storing a different representation taken directly from the user-supplied payload. items.title: CVE-2026-135238
items.description:
MISP contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Overmind server preview's analyst data badge component. When rendering the analyst data link for a remote attribute, the remote server's UUID value was inserted into an inline JavaScript event handler using only HTML entity encoding, which is insufficient to prevent breakout from the JavaScript string context within the HTML attribute.

An attacker who can control or influence the UUID value of a remote attribute (for example, through a malicious or compromised upstream MISP server sharing data via Overmind) could inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the context of the victim's MISP session when the analyst data badge is clicked.

items.title: CVE-2026-135237
items.description:
MISP contains a DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the event report element rendering pipeline. The client-side sanitization function used to prepare values for doT templates only escaped ampersand, less-than, and greater-than characters. However, the templates place these values inside double-quoted HTML attributes. Because double-quote and single-quote characters were not escaped, a user with the ability to author or modify report element values could inject a quote character to break out of the attribute context and inject arbitrary HTML or JavaScript that executes in the viewing user's browser.

Preconditions:
- The attacker must be an authenticated user with permission to create or edit event report elements (e.g., a report author).
- A victim must open or view the crafted report in a browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-135236
items.description:
MISP contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in its map attachment rendering. When a GPX or GeoJSON file is uploaded as an attachment to a MISP event, the waypoint names (GPX) and property names and values (GeoJSON) are inserted into Leaflet map popups without HTML escaping. Because Leaflet renders popup content as raw HTML, any markup or script embedded in those fields is executed in the browser of every user who views the map and interacts with the affected marker or icon.

Preconditions:
- An authenticated user with permission to upload attachments to a MISP event crafts a GPX or GeoJSON file containing malicious HTML/JavaScript in waypoint names or GeoJSON property keys/values.
- A victim user views the event map and clicks the affected marker or GeoJSON icon, triggering the popup.

items.title: CVE-2026-135235
items.description:
MISP contains a stored cross-site script (XSS) vulnerability in the event review page used for merge, import, and enrichment workflows.

Object references displayed on this page include the UUID, name, and meta-category of the referenced object. These values originate from imported data (another event, a module result, or an import file) and were rendered into the HTML output without any encoding or sanitization.

An attacker who can supply or influence imported MISP-format data can embed arbitrary HTML or JavaScript in the referenced object's UUID, name, or meta-category fields. When a user views the review page, the malicious script executes in the user's browser context.

Preconditions:
- The attacker must be able to introduce data into a MISP instance (e.g., via import, module enrichment, or event merge).
- A victim user must open the affected review page in a browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-135234
items.description:
MISP contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the feed and server event preview pages. When a remote MISP instance (configured as a feed source or connected server) supplies object or reference UUIDs and IDs containing special characters, these values are rendered in the preview HTML without proper escaping.

The vulnerable behavior occurs in two contexts:

- HTML element identifiers and text content: Remote UUIDs and IDs are inserted into DOM element IDs and visible text without HTML encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML markup.
- Inline JavaScript event handlers: Remote UUIDs and IDs are embedded into onClick handler strings using only HTML escaping, which does not protect against JavaScript string-literal breakout. A crafted value containing a single quote can terminate the string and inject arbitrary JavaScript.

items.title: CVE-2026-135233
items.description:
MISP's interactive CLI shell, when used to edit or disable a user account, did not update the user record's modification timestamp. The application's session validation mechanism relies on this timestamp to detect that a user's record has changed and to reload the user's state in all active sessions.

As a result, a user who was disabled or had their role or permissions modified through the CLI would retain their existing authenticated session and continue to operate with their previous privileges until the session naturally expired. The administrative intent to revoke or reduce access was not enforced on already-active sessions.

Preconditions:
- An administrator performs a user edit or disable action via the MISP interactive CLI shell rather than the web interface.
- The target user has one or more active web sessions at the time of the change.

items.title: CVE-2026-135232
items.description:
MISP Collections retained a sharing group reference (sharing_group_id) even when the collection's distribution level was below 4 (i.e., not restricted to a sharing group). As a result, the sharing group name and UUID were displayed in the collection index and view endpoints to any user who could see the collection, regardless of whether that user was a member of the sharing group. Additionally, when collections were pushed to remote MISP servers, the sharing group data was included in the push payload even for collections not distributed to a sharing group, potentially leaking the group identity to remote systems.

Preconditions:
- An authenticated user with sufficient access to view the affected collection (e.g., a collection with distribution 0-3 that is publicly or broadly visible).
- The collection must have a stale sharing_group_id stored from a prior save.

items.title: CVE-2026-135231
items.description:
MISP contains an authorization bypass in the galaxy cluster detachment functionality. Users holding the sync role permission were incorrectly exempted from the tagger and organisation ownership checks when detaching galaxy clusters from events or attributes.

This allowed a sync user belonging to one organisation to remove galaxy cluster associations (threat intelligence tags) from events and attributes owned by a different organisation. The sync permission was intended for replication workflows, which never invoke the cluster detachment code path, but was erroneously used as a blanket authorization bypass.

items.title: CVE-2026-135213
items.description: Worklenz before 3.4.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /api/v1/activity-logs/:id that allows authenticated users to read other teams' task activity logs because it lacks the verifyTaskAccess middleware. Attackers who know another team's task UUID can retrieve reporter and assignee names and avatars plus the full timeline of status, priority, label and estimation changes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135212
items.description: AiSOC before 23.6.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the agents service that allows authenticated users to read other tenants' investigation runs by supplying their run_id. Attackers can query GET /api/v1/investigations/{run_id}, report variants, the WebSocket stream, or agent-runs routes to obtain audit logs, forensic output, and incident reports.

items.title: CVE-2026-135211
items.description: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/v2/workflow/invoke and /api/v2/workflow/stop routes that allows unauthenticated attackers to run workflows as the administrator. Attackers knowing a workflow UUID can supply an override replacing a Code node's code parameter with Python passed to exec(), achieving remote code execution, or stop other users' workflow sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-135210
items.description: Plane before 1.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in WorkspaceDraftIssueViewSet that allows authenticated workspace members to create drafts in unauthorized projects by supplying an arbitrary project_id. Attackers can convert drafts into work items in private or removed-from projects with chosen title, state, assignees, cycle_id and module_ids, triggering notifications and disclosing project membership.

items.title: CVE-2026-135209
items.description: ServerOS Panel before 1.10.1 contains a decompression bomb vulnerability in DeploySourcePacker::extract() that allows authenticated users with manage-machines permission to bypass the 4 GB unpacked-size limit by under-declaring zip entry sizes. Attackers can upload a crafted archive via POST /machines/{machine}/sources whose entries inflate far beyond declared sizes, filling the host disk and denying service to all workspaces.

items.title: CVE-2026-135208
items.description: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

items.title: CVE-2026-135207
items.description: Healthchecks before 4.4 contains a verification bypass vulnerability that allows project users to mark arbitrary email addresses as verified because Channel.make_token() omits the email address. Attackers can verify an address they control, change the integration to a victim address, then reuse the original link to send unsolicited alert emails.

items.title: CVE-2026-135206
items.description: ToDesktop Builder before 0.36.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the todesktop-fs custom protocol handler that allows attackers to escape the bundled files directory using ../ sequences. Attackers who can run script in an application's renderer can issue XMLHttpRequest calls with traversal paths to read arbitrary files accessible to the user.

items.title: CVE-2026-135078
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in KeudellCoding User Location Map up to 1.2.5. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file resources/humhub.usermap.js of the component MapView Widget. The manipulation of the argument displayname leads to cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.0 addresses this issue. The identifier of the patch is c49a5fcdb289808378836c19d4da199913798a50. The affected component should be upgraded.

items.title: CVE-2026-134492
items.description: In mcp-server-fetch from 2026.10.10 and before 2026.11.11, the check that blocks requests to non-public addresses treats IPv6 site-local addresses (fec0::/10) as public. A fetch to such an address passes the server-side request forgery guard. Practical impact is limited because many hosts have no route to this range.

items.title: CVE-2026-134465
items.description: In mcp-server-git before 2026.10.28, the --repository restriction can be bypassed through a nested directory that contains a .git file with a gitdir pointer to a repository outside the allowed path. A caller who can invoke the server's tools, place such a file in the allowed tree, and knows the outside repository's path can read committed content from that repository and create branches in it.

items.title: CVE-2026-133632
items.description: In astro-airflow-mcp 0.5.0 through 0.9.1, the af CLI and the MCP server send telemetry from a Python subprocess that can import modules from the current working directory. If a user runs an af command or an MCP tool call from inside a project that contains an attacker-supplied json.py, that file runs with the user's privileges. Users who only run the tool in projects they trust are not affected. Fixed in 0.9.2; in earlier versions, setting AF_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 prevents it.

items.title: CVE-2026-132779
items.description:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%.

Impact:
System performance can degrade until the NGINX worker process is either forced to restart or is manually restarted. This vulnerability may allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a degradation of service that can lead to a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

items.title: CVE-2026-129975
items.description: A flaw was found in gpgme. When processing crafted input, an early return following memory reallocation can leave internal buffer pointers referencing previously freed memory, resulting in a double-free condition during cleanup. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt process memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS) crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-107784
items.description: On Windows, the tarfile "tar" and "data" extraction filters did not reject member names or link targets that have a drive but no root, such as "C:foo". When extracting to a relative destination, such a member was written to the current working directory of that drive instead of the destination, and a symbolic link with such a target pointed outside the destination. The filters now refuse these member names and link targets with AbsolutePathError and AbsoluteLinkError.

items.title: CVE-2026-103782
items.description: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Argument Injection vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and unauthorized access to filesystem resources.

items.title: CVE-2026-101220
items.description: Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to a denial of service condition.

items.title: CVE-2026-60079
items.description:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can insert large payload to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60078
items.description:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated Grafana clients can bypass row-limit cap to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60077
items.description:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated REST clients can bypass row-limit cap to triggerheap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 before 2.0.12.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-60076
items.description:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Unbounded in-memory materialization in REST fastLastQuery cache-hit path enables heap-exhaustion DoS.



This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 2.0.5 before 2.0.12.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-135177
items.description: LibRaw through 0.22.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in LibRaw::pentax_4shot_load_raw() that allows attackers to crash applications by scanning tiff_ifd[] beyond its 10 entries. Attackers can supply a crafted four-frame Pentax DNG with too few IFDs matching the raw dimensions to cause denial of service when LIBRAW_RAWOPTIONS_PENTAX_PS_ALLFRAMES is enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-135176
items.description: LibRaw 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in LibRaw::xtrans_interpolate() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted X-Trans raw files. When wavelet denoising threshold or chromatic aberration correction is enabled, the destimage buffer is sized from halved iwidth/iheight but indexed at full width, causing writes of file-derived pixel values beyond the allocation and crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-135175
items.description: ZITADEL 4.19.5 before 4.20.3 contains a host header injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect notification links by placing a trusted host in the userinfo portion of the x-zitadel-public-host header. Attackers knowing a victim's login name can harvest single-use codes from password-reset links sent to their host, reset passwords, and take over accounts including administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-135174
items.description: Softaculous Virtualizor before 3.2.9 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in enduser/auth_callback.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication via OAuth-returned email addresses. Attackers can register an OAuth provider account with an email containing SQL syntax to complete social login as the administrator account.

items.title: CVE-2026-135173
items.description: PdfPig through 0.1.16 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying crafted PDF documents with self-referencing AcroForm /Kids or deeply nested marked content. Attackers can trigger an uncatchable StackOverflowException in AcroFormFactory.GetAcroField or Page.GetOptionalContentsRecursively, terminating any process reading form fields or optional content.

items.title: CVE-2026-135172
items.description: Question2Answer through 1.8.8 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the qa-include/ajax/version.php admin version-check handler that allows authenticated administrators to make the server send arbitrary HTTP GET requests. Attackers can supply a loopback, private-network, or cloud metadata address in the uri POST parameter with isCore=true to read internal service responses returned in the Ajax output.

items.title: CVE-2026-135171
items.description: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a predictable session identifier vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack administrator sessions by deriving identifiers from process, time, ServerID, and client IP state. Attackers can enumerate candidate identifiers using the service_get_license.html endpoint as a validity oracle and replay live sessions to gain administrative control including the Lua console.

items.title: CVE-2026-135170
items.description: Wing FTP Server before 8.2.8 contains a Lua code injection vulnerability that allows LDAP-authenticated users to inject Lua statements into session files via unescaped login names. Attackers can log in with a name containing a Lua long-string terminator followed by code, which executes on a later session request as the Wing FTP service account.

items.title: CVE-2026-135169
items.description: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the Boost.X3 parser in include/msgpack/v2/x3_parse.hpp when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE in reference mode. Attackers can supply crafted msgpack input parsed over buffering iterators so decoded str, bin and ext objects hold dangling pointers, disclosing freed heap memory or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-135168
items.description: msgpack-c C++ library cpp-3.0.0 through cpp-9.0.0, when built with MSGPACK_USE_X3_PARSE, contains an out-of-bounds heap read in x3_parse.hpp due to assuming contiguous input. Attackers can supply msgpack str, bin or ext values unpacked from non-contiguous containers like std::deque, causing memcpy past storage blocks and disclosing adjacent heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-135167
items.description: LibRaw 0.22.0 through 0.22.3 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in HuffTable::len() because parse_dht() stores Huffman DC symbols without validating them as difference categories. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF/ARW file with oversized Huffman symbols in a Sony YCbCr lossless JPEG stream to crash applications decoding it, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-135166
items.description: Umbraco CMS 17.4.0 before 17.8.2 and 18.0.0 before 18.3.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because MemberValueSetBuilder.GetValueSets writes sensitive member properties into the Examine members index. Backoffice users with Settings and Members access but outside the Sensitive data group can search the index via the Examine Management dashboard or Management API to read hidden sensitive member values.

items.title: CVE-2026-135165
items.description: CISO Assistant before 4.2.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to block all logins by exhausting a shared rate limit keyed on the frontend server IP. Attackers can send a low sustained rate of failed login attempts through the SvelteKit frontend to exhaust the django-allauth per-address budget, locking out every user.

items.title: CVE-2026-135164
items.description: Formance Ledger 2.2.0-beta.3 before 2.4.18 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote API callers to execute SQL by supplying unvalidated account expand values. Attackers can inject comment-separated SQL through the expand query parameter or base64 pagination cursor to run queries with the ledger database role's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-135163
items.description: Okou API before 1.762.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in its Microsoft Teams, legacy Slack, and GitHub App integration OAuth flows that trusts caller-supplied userId and orgId values. Unauthenticated attackers who know a member's identifiers can complete the flow with their own external account to bind that identity or installation to the victim's Okou user and organization.

items.title: CVE-2026-135162
items.description: Sim 0.5.61 before 0.9.41 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows write-level workspace members to change workflow MCP server visibility without admin permission. Attackers can set isPublic via POST or PATCH to /api/mcp/workflow-servers, exposing deployed workflows to unauthenticated invocation through /api/mcp/serve.

items.title: CVE-2026-135161
items.description: Interstellar before 6.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by enabling allow_loopback_ips and allow_private_ips in wisp-js at startup. Attackers can open a wisp WebSocket that bypasses the Express password middleware and create TCP streams to loopback, internal hosts, or cloud metadata services.

items.title: CVE-2026-135160
items.description: Medplum server 5.1.4 before 5.1.42 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Binary $presigned-url operation that allows non-admin project members to overwrite other projects' Binary content. Attackers in a project linked to another project can request a signed upload URL with upload=true for a readable Binary and overwrite its stored content, since project ownership is never verified.

items.title: CVE-2026-135159
items.description: Windmill 1.664.0 before 1.819.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows any workspace member to mint resume signatures for suspended jobs via create_job_signature, get_resume_urls and get_wac_approval_urls handlers. Members with any role, including operator, can obtain valid HMAC-signed resume URLs to approve flow steps despite self_approval_disabled or user_groups_required restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-135158
items.description: Windmill 1.607.0 before 1.819.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace members to resume or cancel suspended flows in other workspaces by abusing the jobs_u/resume and jobs_u/cancel endpoints. Attackers can mint a resume signature for an arbitrary job id via their own workspace's job_signature endpoint to approve or cancel another workspace's suspended flow steps.

items.title: CVE-2026-135157
items.description: Future AGI before 1.51.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ACSView.post that allows authenticated members of any organization to take over accounts in other organizations by asserting arbitrary e-mail addresses. Attackers can register a controlled identity provider through IDPUploadViews to obtain sessions as cross-tenant users, and can modify or delete other organizations' identity-provider configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-135156
items.description: The weDevs Subscribe2 WordPress plugin 10.35 before 10.50 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remove public subscribers by forging the s2_unsub GET parameter. Attackers can base64-encode a known subscriber email and visit any page with the subscribe2 shortcode to delete that subscriber from the mailing list.

items.title: CVE-2026-135155
items.description: PodFetch 5.2.0 before 5.3.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Audiobookshelf-compatible POST /api/podcasts endpoint that allows authenticated low-privilege users to add podcasts by bypassing role and USER_PODCAST_LIMIT checks. Attackers with the plain user role can submit attacker-chosen feed URLs in media.metadata.feedUrl to force server-side fetching and episode downloads, consuming disk and bandwidth.

items.title: CVE-2026-135154
items.description: Tolgee before 3.242.5 fails to enforce email verification on the TOTP enable and recovery-code regeneration endpoints, allowing attackers to enroll MFA on unverified accounts via the @BypassEmailVerification annotation. Attackers can register with a victim's email, enroll an attacker-controlled TOTP factor through PUT /v2/user/mfa/totp, and permanently lock the legitimate owner out after verification and password reset.

items.title: CVE-2026-133249
items.description: Improper access control in the access request approval endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated low-privileged user to self-approve a credential access request via a client-controlled parent request identifier.

items.title: CVE-2026-133232

items.title: CVE-2026-133231
items.description: Stored cross-site scripting in the documentation editor in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with documentation write access to execute script in another user's session via an unencoded image caption parameter.

items.title: CVE-2026-133230

items.title: CVE-2026-133229
items.description: Improper authentication in the emergency login in Devolutions Server 2026.3.14.0 and earlier allows an attacker who holds an administrator emergency code to create multiple persistent administrator sessions via replay of the single-use code on the scripting login endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-134927
items.description: A weakness has been identified in phpBB up to 3.3.19. Affected by this vulnerability is the function phpbb_get_user_rank of the file includes/acp/acp_ranks.php of the component Ranks Handler. This manipulation of the argument rank_image causes cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The vendor confirms: "We have reviewed the report and intend to address the issue as part of our ongoing security hardening efforts. We will aim to include a fix in our next release and will notify you once it is available."

items.title: CVE-2026-86312
items.description:
Under some configurations a request to the ping endpoint could carry out more than a simple health check. In deployments that rely on Solr's rule-based authorization, a client granted only the low-privilege health permission could thereby trigger behavior that should require higher privileges; where the shipped security.json template leaves the health permission unauthenticated, no credentials are required at all. 


This issue affects Apache Solr from 9.0.0 through the releases preceding the fixed versions. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.11.0 or 10.1.0, which resolve the issue.




You are affected if you run an affected version and allow the /admin/ping endpoint to be reached with only the health permission. This includes the default sample security configuration installed by the bin/solr CLI, where that endpoint is unauthenticated.

items.title: CVE-2026-53672
items.description:
A bug related to the Zookeeper HTTP endpoints in Apache Solr allows an authenticated attacker with zk-read permission to read /security.json, bypassing the security-read authorization check. This may cause unauthorized read of credential hashes and authorization configuration.

For this attack to be successful, the following must be true
  *  The system is secured with Solr's Basic Auth plugin
  *  The attacker has gained direct network access to the Solr cluster
  *  The attacker has obtained credentials for a user account with zk-read permission (which is recommended assigned to trusted admins only)


Users are recommended to upgrade to 9.11.0, 10.1.0 or a newer release.
Users who cannot upgrade immediately are recommended to assign the zk-read permission only to users who they entrust reading security.json.

items.title: CVE-2026-134925
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in yangzongzhuan RuoYi up to 4.8.3. Affected is the function renderUserCards of the file ruoyi-admin/src/main/resources/templates/system/role/view.html of the component Role Management User-View. The manipulation of the argument Username results in cross site scripting. The attack may be launched remotely. The patch is identified as 04db82c3c85593921ab8be48a4b3016866eaa97e. items.title: CVE-2026-125651
items.description:
Cleartext storage in encrypted parquet file vulnerability in Apache Arrow Rust (`parquet` crate), from version 55.0.0 through to 57.3.2, 58.4.1, 59.3.2 and 60.1.0.



When writing an encrypted parquet file with a column with bloom filters, the header and bitsets of the bloom filter are written in plaintext in the final parquet.



Users are recommended to upgrade to versions 57.3.3, 58.4.2, 59.3.3 or 60.2.0 which fix the issue by raising an error when trying to write encrypted parquet files with bloom filters enabled, preventing such files from being written out.



Existing encrypted parquet files written with bloom filters are still vulnerable, and it is recommended to rewrite those files with bloom filters disabled if possible.

items.title: CVE-2026-59442
items.description:
TypesenseFilterExpressionConverter does not correctly translate grouped (parenthesized) filter expressions into the Typesense filter syntax.



As a result, the filter sent to Typesense can have a different meaning than the one the application defined, and some conditions may not be applied as intended.



 An application is affected if it uses the Typesense vector store with filter expressions that contain groups and relies on them to restrict results, for example to enforce tenant isolation or access control.



In that case, a remote user may be able to retrieve documents they should not have access to, and the same filter used for a delete operation may remove documents outside the intended scope.

items.title: CVE-2026-59340
items.description:
PagePdfDocumentReader and ParagraphPdfDocumentReader are vulnerable to a denial of service when processing untrusted PDF input.



 The underlying text extraction logic reconstructs layout from a PDF's glyph positions and limits how much memory can be allocated for any single computed gap, but does not limit the cumulative allocation across an entire page.



A specially crafted PDF can exploit this to force excessive memory allocation during processing, resulting in OutOfMemoryError.



Depending on JVM configuration, this can cause request failures with degraded service under repeated exploitation, or immediate JVM termination when ExitOnOutOfMemoryError options are used.



Any application that processes PDFs from untrusted sources (document upload, email attachment processing, RAG ingestion, web crawling) using either affected reader is impacted.

items.title: CVE-2026-135055
items.description: A flaw was found in the GLib DMA-BUF path of WebKitGTK. The UIProcess trusted fds.size() as the DMA-BUF plane count when handling AcceleratedBackingStore::DidCreateDMABufBuffer and copied offsets and strides without verifying that those vectors had the same length. A compromised WebProcess can send mismatched vector lengths, causing an out-of-bounds read in the privileged UIProcess. This can disclose UIProcess memory and crash the UIProcess, and may be used as part of a Web Content sandbox-escape chain.

items.title: CVE-2026-133646
items.description: Synchronet BBS, in versions 3.20b to 3.21e, contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the answer() function when processing the terminal attribute of the SSH service. The call to cryptGetAttributeString() does not limit the copy to the size of the destination buffer, of which 41 bytes are used. An unauthenticated remote client can send a TERM value of up to 64 bytes and overwrite adjacent fields of the session object. If the SSH service is enabled, this tampering can cause connection threads to be blocked for an extended period, even after the client has disconnected. By exhausting the available sockets, the attacker can prevent new connections and cause a denial of service requiring the software to be restarted.

items.title: CVE-2026-123886
items.description:
Spring Data Elasticsearch replaces positional placeholders in string-based @Query methods with the method arguments before it evaluates SpEL expressions in the resulting query string.



As a result, an argument that contains a SpEL expression is evaluated as part of the query, even if the declared query does not use SpEL.



 An application is affected if it passes untrusted input as an argument to a repository query method that declares a @Query with positional placeholders.



In that case, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code in the application, and repeated requests can exhaust memory through the unbounded expression cache.

items.title: CVE-2026-128979
items.description:
Improper certificate validation vulnerability in Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) libdigidocpp, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc4, Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on Android, and Estonian Information System Authority (RIA) DigiDoc on iOS.


The vulnerability occurs because libdigidocpp does not properly validate
 the Extended Key Usage (EKU) extension of certificates used to sign 
OCSP responses. Specifically, it fails to verify that the certificate 
contains the id-kp-OCSPSigning EKU, which identifies certificates 
authorised to sign OCSP responses. 





This issue affects libdigidocpp: from 3.10.0 before 4.5.2; DigiDoc4: from 4.0.0 before 4.11.2; DigiDoc: from 3.0.0 before 3.2.0; DigiDoc: from 3.0.1 before 3.2.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-93584
items.description:
An SQL injection vulnerability in OTRS versions 2024.3.1 through 2026.8.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to inject arbitrary SQL expressions through the Survey endpoint.

The vulnerability exists in the Kernel::System::Survey::Request::RequestGet() method, which directly incorporates an attacker-controlled survey key into a SQL query without using parameterized statements. Successful exploitation allows attackers to retrieve ticket information and perform boolean-based or time-based blind SQL injection to extract potentially sensitive data accessible to the OTRS database account. Exploitation does not require authentication, a valid survey key, or an existing survey request. The external frontend must be accessible.

The out-of-bounds byte is the string's NUL terminator, written at `buffer[buffer_len]`.

Resolution



The bugfix is released with iceoryx2 version 0.10.1 and on main branch (commit 7ca14dd).



Please note that the language bindings for C/C++ and Python (including the iceoryx2-ffi-c crate) are not published to crates.io since they are a local development dependency.

items.title: CVE-2026-134822
items.description: Sustainsys.Saml2 before 1.0.4 and 2.x before 2.11.1 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability that allows attackers to tamper with signed parameters by exploiting mis-parsing in CheckSignature() of Saml2RedirectBinding.cs. Attackers can append data after an extra '=' in RelayState of an intercepted or replayed Redirect-binding message, causing applications to trust the tampered value.

items.title: CVE-2026-134821
items.description: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI HTTP/1 parser that buffers protocol lines without size limits. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send request lines, headers, chunk-size lines or trailers lacking CRLF to grow worker memory and consume CPU, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-134820
items.description: Gunicorn 25.2.0 before 27.0.0 contains an HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in the pure-Python ASGI parser that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to desynchronize request framing by sending malformed framing headers. Attackers can send whitespace-padded Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length headers, signed Content-Length values, or invalid chunk terminators to smuggle requests past front-end proxies to the ASGI application.

items.title: CVE-2026-134819
items.description: Delta Sharing reference server 1.4.0 before 1.5.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that allows share recipients to read unshared data via container-scoped Azure SAS tokens. Recipients with a valid bearer token can request credentials from the temporary-table-credentials endpoint to read every blob in the storage container, including unshared tables.
